integrity: Analytic all-size proof from exact Bessel winding expansion; numerical finite-size tests only corroborate and do not constitute an infinite proof. No independent validation or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed uniform Peierls-phase gauge, coherent nearest-neighbor unitary evolution, initial vertex state, one full position-resolving measurement, fixed nonexceptional flux for small-time expansions. The ordinary score Fisher information is nonregular at some zero-probability blind points. No inference about noisy sensors or gauge-independent quantum Fisher information. Priority risk remains for inaccessible complete manuscript arxiv:2608.12519v1 and unindexed/implicit antecedents.
title: Parity-dependent flux-information bottlenecks in position-resolved quantum ring walks
